Identification.LongTitle: An Act to amend the Criminal Code (trafficking in persons)
Identification.RunningHead: An Act to amend the Criminal Code (trafficking in persons)

Provision.Text: This enactment amends the Criminal Code to specify what constitutes exploitation for the purpose of establishing whether a person has committed the offence of trafficking in persons.
His Majesty, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate and House of Commons of Canada, enacts as follows:

Subsection.Text: Subsection 279.04(1) of the Criminal Code is replaced by the following:
For the purposes of sections 279.01 to 279.03, a person exploits another person if they engage in conduct that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: causes the other person to provide or offer to provide labour or a service; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: involves, in relation to any person, the use or threatened use of force or another form of coercion, the use of deception or fraud, the abuse of a position of trust, power or authority, or any other similar act.

Subsection.Text: Subsection 279.04(2) of the Act is repealed.
